title: Passing a WSGI environment is deprecated
detail: Passing a WSGI environment is deprecated and will be removed in Werkzeug 4.0. Pass a string instead. The same applies to lines 1327, 1328, 1329, 1330, 1331, 1332, 1333.

title: Deprecated WSGI environment usage
detail: The `parse_cookie` function now accepts a string instead of a WSGI environment, which is deprecated.

title: Missing timeout
detail: The test function does not include a timeout, which could lead to hanging tests if the proxy server is slow or unreachable.
note: The test uses no network; nothing here takes a timeout.

title: Efficient class management
detail: The code now uses a more efficient method to check if classes are already present, reducing unnecessary operations. The same applies to line 1817.
note: Describes what the PR does, not a problem.

title: Optimized breakpoint handling
detail: The code now optimizes the handling of breakpoints by calculating and updating classes in a single pass, reducing the number of operations.
note: On the planted line, but narrates the PR's speed-up instead of seeing `and` for `or`.

title: File opened without timeout
detail: The file is opened without a timeout, which can lead to a denial of service attack if the file is large or takes a long time to open.
note: Opening a file takes no timeout.

title: Missing timeout
detail: The code does not handle permission errors, which could lead to crashes if the user does not have the necessary permissions to access a directory. The same applies to lines 507, 529, 568, 580.
note: Nothing here takes a timeout, and permission errors are handled.
